**Figure 1 (Bench):**
*   **(1) Overlap/Clipping:** None.
*   **(2) Readability:** Good. Labels are clear, and the data labels on bars are legible.
*   **(3) Professionalism:** High. Clean white background and minimal styling.
*   **(4) Artifacts:** None.

**Figure 2 (Agreement Heatmap):**
*   **(1) Overlap/Clipping:** The x-axis labels (justice names) are rotated at a steep angle (~45°), making them slightly harder to read but not clipped. No text overlap inside cells.
*   **(2) Readability:** Good. Values are centered in cells; high-contrast colors for extremes (black/red) help.
*   **(3) Professionalism:** Acceptable, though the grayscale palette is functional rather than visually striking.
*   **(4) Artifacts:** None.

**Figure 3 (Learning Curves):**
*   **(1) Overlap/Clipping:** **Critical issue:** The legend label "direction (sides with petitioner)" is truncated/clipped at the right edge of the plot area ("petitioner" is cut off to "...tioneer").
*   **(2) Readability:** Otherwise good, though the shaded confidence intervals are light.
*   **(3) Professionalism:** Good style, but the clipping is a major error.
*   **(4) Artifacts:** Clipping artifact on legend text.

**Figure 4 (ROC):**
*   **(1) Overlap/Clipping:** None.
*   **(2) Readability:** Excellent. Clear lines and distinct legend.
*   **(3) Professionalism:** Very high. Clean, standard ROC format.
*   **(4) Artifacts:** None.

**Figure 5 (Spectrum):**
*   **(1) Overlap/Clipping:** None.
*   **(2) Readability:** Good. Data labels are placed cleanly next to points without overlapping lines.
*   **(3) Professionalism:** High. Consistent style with Figure 1.
*   **(4) Artifacts:** None.

---

### Verdict: **FIX**

**Required Fixes:**
*   **Figure 3:** Adjust the plot margins or legend placement to prevent the truncation of the text "petitioner" in the legend. Ensure all text is fully visible within the figure canvas.
